result.summary: Identified 2 minor-to-major visual and functional UI issues regarding filtering consistency and text clipping.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is selected, but items shown across the feed are non-pizza items like Poké and Ramen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure selected category filters dynamically update the visible listings.

issues.description: The title 'Trattoria Piccol' in the horizontal scroll section is abruptly clipped at the edge.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis or adjust container padding.
